development_partition.purpose: Used for rule drafting, pattern refinement, and prototype model training.

validation_partition.purpose: Used for threshold comparison and configuration selection.

locked_test_partition.purpose: Cryptographically frozen benchmark partition used strictly for final reporting.

dataset_role_partitioning.leak_free_verification: Strict campaign isolation: campaigns(dev) & campaigns(val) & campaigns(locked) = empty (zero campaign overlap)

splitting_methodology.strategy: Three-Role Campaign-Isolated Split (Dev / Val / Locked Test)

sample_size_warning: The evaluation corpus contains 39 documented records (19 development, 10 validation, 10 locked test). This sample size is sufficient for regression and integrity testing, but is too small for statistical real-world generalization claims. Metrics must NOT be interpreted as certified production accuracy.
in_sample_tuning_disclosure: HISTORICAL IN-SAMPLE TUNING DISCLOSURE: The reported 100% rule-based accuracy reflects performance on records that were historically available during rule development and edge-case refinement. While the locked test partition is now structurally segregated and frozen via SHA-256 manifest, true out-of-sample validity requires newly collected, unseen advisories acquired after model freeze.

model_comparison.architectural_distinction: The rule-based detector inspects explicit semantic patterns (OTP requests, APK lures, urgency phrases) and active protective negations. The experimental ML baseline models character n-gram frequencies. Agreement between these two methods does NOT constitute independent mathematical proof of maliciousness.
